rule_pack.name: cryptojacking-forensics-alpha
rule_pack.author: Dimple Nemade
rule_pack.scope: Offline byte scanning of supplied artifacts. Indicators for triage only; not proof of compromise.

rules.name: cj_miner_xmrig_config_1
rules.purpose: XMRig configuration/options that co-occur with mining setup
rules.false_positives: security blog posts, training material, benign config snippets

rules.name: cj_stratum_endpoint_1
rules.purpose: Stratum mining-protocol endpoint URI or common mining ports

rules.name: cj_miner_name_weak_1
rules.purpose: Known miner process/binary names (weak indicator on its own)
rules.false_positives: mention of miner names in documentation, logs, code comments
